scripts.start: pm2 delete api 2>/dev/null; pm2 start "bun --hot ." --name api -i 1 && pm2 save
scripts.start-4: pm2 delete api 2>/dev/null; pm2 start "NODE_OPTIONS='--dns-result-order=ipv4first' bun --hot ." --name api -i 1 && pm2 save
scripts.start-6: pm2 delete api 2>/dev/null; pm2 start "NODE_OPTIONS='--dns-result-order=ipv6first' bun --hot ." --name api -i 1 && pm2 save
scripts.gen-update: rm -rf node_modules bun.lock functions routes && curl -L https://github.com/GreenVGJR/api/tarball/main | tar -xz --strip-components=1 && bun install && bun run gen && bun update --latest && npm install -g pm2 && bun run start && npm update -g
scripts.soft-update: curl -L https://github.com/GreenVGJR/api/tarball/main | tar -xz --strip-components=1 && bun install && bun run gen && bun update --latest && npm install -g pm2 && npm update -g
